title: Skyline Co-op
excerpt: SimTower rebuilt around democratic socialism. Manage the money, create the jobs, house the people — and answer to an assembly that can vote you out.
content_html:
What this is — SimTower was a game about being a landlord: build floors, charge rent, watch the money come in. This is the same building run on democratic socialism instead — the people who live and work here own it together and decide what happens to it.

Your job — You are not the owner. You are the steward the residents elected, and you hold the treasury in trust. Everything you build, they live in.

Confidence is the score — Not profit. It rises when people are housed, can get around, can see a doctor, have somewhere to gather, and can afford to stay. The bar at the top tells you where you stand; hover it to see what the assembly likes least.

Homes are allocated, not sold — There is a waitlist. Build homes and households come off it. Dues are set per room in three bands: Reduced brings in less but houses far more people, Full share fills the treasury and prices people out.

Building — Drag Floor to pour space (the ground floor is your lobby). Co-op workspaces pay a share of their surplus. Canteens, cafés, stores and the cinema are run at or near cost — they earn little and are worth a great deal.

Getting around — Drag elevators vertically. Express elevators stop at the lobby, basements and every 5th floor; service elevators carry staff only. Stairs and escalators take the short hops and relieve the queues.

The assembly — At every quarter close the members meet. They vote on major works you propose, they can set you a mandate with a deadline, and if confidence rots long enough they can vote you out. Click Confidence in the top bar to see what you owe and what is waiting on a vote.

Getting around, higher up — A Sky Lobby is a two-floor concourse that every elevator stops at, expresses included, so a long climb becomes two short ones.

The building tells you — Each morning the Assembly Bulletin collects what happened, and the Co-op Gossip feed along the bottom carries the rest: what people said, what the papers printed, and what needs doing.

Trouble — Fires spread until the Safety Team contains them. The treasury is meant to circulate; hoard it and the assembly will vote it out the door — to the school, the library, a sister co-op — and thank you for the surplus.

The summit — A building that houses people well enough, high enough, attracts a public science grant. Crown it with the Observatory and the astronomers arrive.

Controls — Scroll to zoom. Pan by right-dragging, holding Space and left-dragging, or with the arrow keys. P pauses, M mutes, Esc closes panels. Number keys pick tools.

Some say the old codes still work.

content_html_zh:
这是什么——SimTower 是一款关于成为房东的游戏：建造楼层、收取租金、看着钱进来。 这是同一座建立在民主社会主义基础上的建筑——在这里生活和工作的人们共同拥有它并决定它会发生什么。

你的工作——你不是所有者。 你是居民选出的管家，你托管着国库。 你建造的一切，它们都生活在其中。

信心是分数，而不是利润。 当人们有住房、可以四处走动、可以看医生、有地方聚集并且有能力住宿时，它就会上升。 顶部的栏告诉您您的立场；将其悬停以查看程序集最不喜欢的内容。

房屋是分配的，不是出售的——有一个候补名单。 建造房屋和家庭就可以了。 每个房间的会费分为三个等级：减免带来的收入较少，但容纳的人数却多得多；全额共享则填满了国库，并让人们付出了高昂的代价。

建筑 - 拖动地板来浇筑空间（底层是您的大厅）。 合作办公空间支付其盈余的一部分。 食堂、咖啡馆、商店和电影院都是按成本价或接近成本价经营的——它们赚的钱很少，但价值却很高。

四处走动 — 垂直拖动电梯。 快速电梯停靠在大堂、地下室和每5层；服务电梯仅载送工作人员。 楼梯和自动扶梯可以缩短行程并缓解排队的情况。

大会——每个季度结束时，成员们都会举行会议。 他们对你提出的主要作品进行投票，他们可以为你设定一个有截止日期的任务，如果信心消失的时间足够长，他们可以投票让你下台。 单击顶部栏中的“置信度”可查看您欠的金额以及等待投票的金额。

四处走动，更高处 — 空中大堂是一个两层楼的大厅，每部电梯都停在其中，包括在内，因此长距离的攀登变成了两个短距离的攀登。

这座大楼告诉你——每天早上，大会公报都会收集发生的事情，而底部的合作社八卦则包含其余内容：人们说了什么，报纸印了什么，以及需要做什么。

麻烦 — 火势蔓延直至安全团队将其控制住。 国库是用来流通的；把它囤积起来，议会就会投票把它赶出家门——送到学校、图书馆、姐妹合作社——并感谢你们的剩余。

山顶——一座能够为人们提供足够舒适、足够高的建筑，吸引公共科学资助。 天文台加冕，天文学家到达。

控件 — 滚动以缩放。 通过右键拖动、按住空格键并向左拖动或使用箭头键进行平移。 P 暂停，M 静音，Esc 关闭面板。 数字键选择工具。

有人说旧代码仍然有效。
